text:
laura: Heads up — I'm opening a tiny docs PR to annotate the Optimize toolkit snippets. Main changes: rename kv-prefetch -> kv_cache, add a short language matrix (py/js/go), and call out a quant-profile caveat for short-sequence workloads. PR in ~5m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620
chris: LGTM. can you add a one-line table that shows behavior parity across py/js/go? we had a mismatch in the Go snippet last week.
maya: also please call out the perf regression we saw with the short-seq quant profile (brief note, link to the eval) — that'll save support back-and-forth.
kevin: while you're at it, update any internal Console links that point to /optimize/guide -> we recently moved the path and got a 404 in the sample app.
laura: good catches. i'll include a 3-row language matrix and the quant caveat. adding linkcheck step to the PR description.
laura: Go snippet i'll add:
```go
// Go client: enable KV cache (was kv-prefetch)
client := redwood.NewClient(opts)
client.Optimize().SetKVCache(true)
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
```
chris: perfect. for JS example use streaming + batching example so folks see the interplay — e.g., `stream: true` + `batchSize: 8`.
laura: noted, i'll keep examples <40 lines each. samir — you good to review when it's up?
docs-bot: label added: docs/optkit, status: needs-review
samir: happy to review, i'll focus on clarity and link sanity. :eyes:
laura: pushing the branch now and adding the language matrix and quant note. PR link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620|#1620> — ping when you start review.
chris: small nit: call out default behavior for `kv_cache` when disabled (falls back to runtime prefix caching). saves confusion.
laura: done, added one sentence and a short snippet showing fallback behavior.
maya: thanks — can you also add a one-line migration tip for teams that have custom batching logic? just say to verify microbatch boundaries after renaming.
laura: added that under "migration notes". pushing final patch.
samir: grabbing it now. will leave inline comments if anything's unclear. :thumbsup:
laura: thanks all — i'll merge after one approval and run the docs link-check job. if anybody spots a stray path, reply here and i'll include the fix in the same PR.
kevin: tacked a follow-up: if we change any console anchors, open a redirect ticket with infra so external links don't break. added to the PR description.
laura: nice, added infra-redirects checklist. merging on green. :party:
